theorems.statement: (∀ (d : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid d)) (y : Euclid d), Tendsto (fun r => volume (Z ∩ closedBall y r) / volume (closedBall y r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) → ∀ v : Euclid d, ‖v‖ = 1 → ∃ ys : ℕ → Euclid d, (∀ i, ys i ∈ Z ∧ ys i ≠ y) ∧ Tendsto ys atTop (𝓝 y) ∧ Tendsto (fun i => ‖ys i - y‖⁻¹ • (ys i - y)) atTop (𝓝 v)) → ∀ (d : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid d)) (F u : Euclid d → ℝ) (K : NNReal) (a b : ℝ), MeasurableSet Z → Differentiable ℝ F → LipschitzWith K u → a < b → (∀ y ∈ Z, u y = min 1 (max 0 ((b - F y) / (b - a)))) → ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Euclid d)), y ∈ Z → fderiv ℝ u y = (if a < F y ∧ F y < b then -(b - a)⁻¹ else 0) • fderiv ℝ F y
